reference.note: v0 = SO-101 URDF geometry + MG996R on wrist_flex, wrist_roll, gripper + concept base. Replaced by v1 from the team CAD (FreeCAD) and v2 from measurements of the built arm.

sts3215_12v.accel_source: assumed: reach the speed cap in ~0.3 s; STS3215 register 41 (0-254 x 8.7 deg/s^2) can do it in the servo; tune in P009
sts3215_12v.source: Feetech C018 datasheet A/0 2023-07-20: 0.222 s/60deg at 12V, stall 30 kg.cm, rated 10 kg.cm

mg996r_6v.accel_source: assumed: reach the speed cap in ~0.3 s; MG996R has no acceleration setting so the host ramps it; tune in P009
mg996r_6v.source: towerpro.com.tw/product/mg996r: 0.15 s/60deg at 6V, 11 kg.cm at 6V, 55 g; maker answer: travel 0-159deg

joints.name: shoulder_pan
joints.limit_source: D25 base turns a full circle (+-180deg); URDF had +-110deg

joints.name: wrist_flex
joints.limit_source: MG996R travel 159deg centred (+-79.5deg); URDF had +-95deg; confirm in CAD v1

joints.name: wrist_roll
joints.limit_source: MG996R travel 159deg mounted off-centre (-64..+95deg) so the jaws reach a sideways grip (presentation model v0); URDF had -157..+163deg; confirm in CAD v1

joints.name: gripper
joints.limit_source: -10..+40deg: past ~35deg the moving jaw meets the MG996R mounting ears (CAD v1 draft); URDF had -10..+100deg

tcp.name: gripper_frame_link
tcp.source: URDF gripper_frame_joint; fingertip from the meshes is a few mm further out

link_mass_note: base_link mass and the base geometry are still the SO-101 base; the new round base (concept) replaces them in v1

gripper_opening_mm.source: gap between the jaws over the 26 mm grip depth at the 40deg limit, computed from SO-101 meshes, not measured
